row.evidence: Prerender.io's pricing comparison shows "Multi User Accounts (SSO)" only on Enterprise Plus (Custom, Contact Us), its SSO guide says SAML SSO is for Enterprise tier accounts, and no SCIM or user-provisioning API is documented.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none, by absence). Prices changed (pricing table 'Effective date: 09-15-2026'): Starter $59/mo (was $49), Growth $169/mo, Pro $419/mo (was $349), Enterprise Plus custom; the separate 'Enterprise' tier from June is now 'Enterprise Plus'. Prices are flat by render volume and shown monthly only, so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO is set up by Prerender support on a dedicated Keycloak realm for Enterprise-tier accounts. Team members are invited and removed manually (Security and Access > Team Members); the REST API covers cache operations only, not users.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Audit log listed from Growth up (UI feature; no audit-log API documented).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the pricing page, the 136-URL docs sitemap, the SSO guide, the team-account docs or the REST API reference; recorded as none by absence.

limitations.text: REST API is for cache management only; team members are managed in the dashboard.

user_api.notes: A REST API exists on every plan, but it covers cache operations (recache, search, sitemap, cache clear) only; no user or team endpoints are documented.

fallbacks.notes: SSO maps IdP users by email to the account's user structure; whether new users are created just-in-time is not stated.
